text: {"name":"rf_calib_entry_value_get","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Looks up an indexed RF calibration entry and returns zero for the 0xFF marker or a cleared gate, otherwise returning the byte at offset 136 transformed as 13*x+11 modulo 256.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"calibration_index","v1":"calibration_entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":113,"meaning":"Marker byte; 0xFF causes an immediate zero return."},{"offset":132,"meaning":"Gate byte; zero returns zero, nonzero enables the transformed value."},{"offset":136,"meaning":"Source byte for the returned 8-bit affine transform."}]}
